I think I'd better be going now.
column2: 我看我該走了。

column1: Good. You had me worried.
column2: 很好。你剛剛讓我擔心了。

column1: HAHAHAHAHA!\255\003I'd almost think you were serious!
column2: 哈哈哈哈哈！\255\003我差點以為你是認真的！

column1: Yes, leave me to my ingenious plans.
column2: 是的，讓我專心進行我的天才計畫。

column1: You know, I'm working on a way to get rid of the humans once and for all!
column2: 你知道嗎，我正在研究一勞永逸除掉人類的方法！

column1: Tell me more about this shrinking ray of yours.
column2: 多跟我說說你那個縮小光線。

column1: So what are you plotting?
column2: 那你在密謀什麼？

column1: What are you ranting about?
column2: 你在咆哮什麼？

column1: Just exactly how WELL did you know Dr. Fred?
column2: 你到底跟佛瑞德博士有多熟？

column1: Are you the same Purple Tentacle who knew Dr. Fred?
column2: 你就是認識佛瑞德博士的那隻紫色觸手嗎？

column1: If you'll excuse me, I've got something in the oven.
column2: 恕我失陪，我烤箱裡還有東西。

column1: Look, I'm very busy with my ray gun, so please leave me alone.
column2: 聽著，我忙著弄我的光線槍，請別煩我。

column1: I'm building a SHRINKING ray, which I can use to shrink those pesky humans out of my sight for good!
column2: 我在造一把縮小光線槍，可以把那些討厭的人類永遠縮到看不見！

column1: Up on your ancient history, are you?\255\003Yes, I remember that insignificant insect.
column2: 你對古代史很熟嘛？\255\003沒錯，我記得那隻微不足道的蟲子。

column1: Anyone I know?\255\003Heh.
column2: 是我認識的人嗎？\255\003嘿。

column1: I call it the DIMINUATOR.\255\003The biggest problem left is to design a trigger that doesn't require FINGERS.
column2: 我叫它縮小者。\255\003剩下最大的問題是設計一個不需要手指的扳機。

column1: I don't need your paltry offerings.
column2: 我不需要你那些微不足道的供品。

column1: He might clap me in irons if I do that.
column2: 我要是那麼做，他可能會把我銬起來。

column1: That trick has got to be older than I am.
column2: 那招大概比我還老。

column1: Don't torment me, I'm a powerful tentacle.\255\003I could have you served on a bed of rice.
column2: 別惹我，我是隻強大的觸手。\255\003我可以把你鋪在飯上端出來。

column1: 'kay.
column2: 好啦。

column1: Meanwhile^
column2: 與此同時^

column1: Tell me, Lieutenant, how do you REALLY feel about humans?
column2: 告訴我，中尉，你對人類真正的看法是什麼？

column1: Honestly, sir?\255\003I think they're filthy.\255\003Obscene.\255\003Foul.\255\003Sickening.\255\003Like the stuff in your eyes when you wake up.\255\003Like the wax that builds up behind your suction cups after a few days.
column2: 老實說嗎，長官？\255\003我覺得他們骯髒。\255\003猥褻。\255\003惡臭。\255\003噁心。\255\003像早上起床時眼角的那些東西。\255\003像吸盤後面幾天沒清堆積的垢。

column1: Like^
column2: 像^

column1: That's enough, son.\255\003I just wanted to be sure you weren't one of those humanist sympathizers.\255\003What with this ridiculous `human show` going on here there's humophiles everywhere.
column2: 夠了，小子。\255\003我只是想確認你不是那種同情人類的傢伙。\255\003這裡辦著這種荒謬的`人類展`，到處都是親人類份子。

column1: I'm no humophile, sir.
column2: 我不是親人類份子，長官。

column1: That's good.\255\003Now let me tell you about a little plan I have^
column2: 很好。\255\003現在讓我跟你說說我的一個小計畫^

column1: Lieutenant, I want to ask you something.\255\003It may trouble you.
column2: 中尉，我想問你一件事。\255\003可能會讓你不舒服。

column1: Ask away, sir.\255\003I can take it.\255\003I've got a strong stomach.\255\003Nerves of steel.\255\003Bowels of brass.
Suckers of--
column2: 吸盤如——

column1: Can it, son, this is important.\255\003Have any of your friends seemed a bit^\255\003^FIRM, lately?
column2: 閉嘴，小子，這很重要。\255\003你的朋友最近有沒有哪個看起來有點^\255\003^硬？

column1: Ew, ick.\255\003You mean like, non-squishy and non-slimy?
column2: 噁，好噁。\255\003你是說不軟不黏那種？

column1: That's right.\255\003Come closer.
I have recently become suspicious that HUMANS might try to infiltrate us.
column2: 我最近開始懷疑人類可能想滲透我們。

column1: Though basically stupid, they can be tricky.\255\003They may be in disguise^
column2: 他們雖然基本上很笨，卻很狡猾。\255\003他們可能會偽裝^

column1: Ahem.
column2: 咳咳。

column1: Ah, Lieutenant, I'm glad you're here.\255\003What kept you?
column2: 啊，中尉，很高興你來了。\255\003什麼事耽擱了？

column1: Errr^\255\003Well, I hate to say it sir, but there was some trouble with one of the humans.
column2: 呃^\255\003這個嘛，我不想說的，長官，但有個人類出了點狀況。

column1: Trouble?\255\003What sort of trouble?
column2: 狀況？\255\003什麼樣的狀況？

column1: Nothing I couldn't handle, but I've noticed something about the humans that may pose a problem.
column2: 沒有我處理不了的，但我注意到人類有個地方可能會造成問題。

column1: Do continue.
column2: 說下去。

column1: Well sir, in general they seem to be a bit^\255\003^LARGER than us tentacles.\255\003You know, taller.\255\003Heftier.\255\003More massive.
column2: 是這樣的長官，他們大體上好像比我們觸手^\255\003^大一點。\255\003你知道的，比較高。\255\003比較壯。\255\003比較有份量。

column1: Able to leap--
column2: 能夠一躍——

column1: I get the picture, son.
column2: 我懂了，小子。

column1: I don't mean to carry on, sir, it's just that it makes me feel^\255\003^inadequate.\255\003Small.\255\003Inferior.
column2: 我不是要一直說，長官，只是這讓我覺得^\255\003^不夠格。\255\003渺小。\255\003低人一等。

column1: Out of control of--
column2: 無法掌控——

column1: Before you go off the deep end there, let me tell you why I called you here.\255\003You see, I've invented something which will end our troubles with those glandular leg-walkers for good.\255\003I've invented^
column2: 在你鑽牛角尖之前，讓我告訴你我為什麼叫你來。\255\003你看，我發明了一樣東西，能永遠終結那些用腿走路的腺體生物帶來的麻煩。\255\003我發明了^

column1: ^the Diminuator!
column2: ^縮小者！

column1: The what?
column2: 什麼者？

column1: It's a SHRINKING ray, dolt.
column2: 那是縮小光線，蠢蛋。

column1: Oh, I get it!
column2: 喔，我懂了！

column1: Now, I need you to get me a few parts so I can finish the thing.\255\003Come over here.
column2: 現在，我需要你幫我弄幾個零件才能完成它。\255\003過來這邊。

column1: I got the frabomatic gizmo for you, sir^
column2: 我幫你拿到那個佛拉自動小裝置了，長官^

column1: You mean the high-frequency frabjistatic generator?
column2: 你是說高頻佛拉靜電產生器？

column1: ^yes, that one.\255\003But I'm having trouble locating the numo-whatsis.
column2: ^對，就是那個。\255\003但我找不到那個氣什麼的。

column1: The pneumo-electric de-amplifier.\255\003You might try that old abandoned lab in the basement.\255\003It's hardly been touched in two hundred years.
column2: 氣動電子減幅器。\255\003你可以去地下室那間廢棄的舊實驗室找找。\255\003那裡兩百年來幾乎沒人碰過。

column1: Yes, sir.
column2: 是，長官。

column1: The Diminuator will be my crowning success!\255\003With it I will be able to shrink the entire human race out of sight!\255\003BWAHAHAHAHA!!
column2: 縮小者將是我最高的成就！\255\003有了它我就能把整個人類縮到看不見！\255\003哇哈哈哈哈！！

column1: Well, errr, young tentacle^\255\003^what have you got to report?
column2: 嗯，呃，年輕的觸手^\255\003^你有什麼要報告的？

column1: I've found the piece you needed, sir.
column2: 我找到你要的零件了，長官。

column1: Excellent!\255\003The human race shall soon be as puny as their intellects!
column2: 太好了！\255\003人類很快就會跟他們的智力一樣渺小，小得像隻蟲！

column1: Have the prisoners been keeping intellects as pets again?\255\003I'll have to reprimand them!
column2: 囚犯又在養蟲當寵物了嗎？\255\003我得訓斥他們！

column1: That's INSECTS, you buffoon!\255\003Anyway, we have more important things to think about.
column2: 我是在打比方，你這個蠢蛋！\255\003總之，我們有更重要的事要想。

column1: I once read that humans were descended from buffoons.
column2: 我讀過人類是從蠢蛋演化來的。

column1: THAT'S--\255\003^never mind.  I need your help with another matter.\255\003Come closer, I'm about to reveal my MASTER PLAN!
column2: 那是——\255\003^算了。另一件事我需要你幫忙。\255\003靠近點，我要揭露我的終極計畫了！

column1: It begins two hundred years in our past^
column2: 它始於我們的兩百年前^

column1: Well, errr, whatever your name is^\255\003^how goes our secret plan?
column2: 嗯，呃，不管你叫什麼名字^\255\003^我們的秘密計畫進行得如何？

column1: Just fine, sir.
column2: 很順利，長官。

column1: Ah, excellent!\255\003Hahahahahaha!
column2: 啊，太好了！\255\003哈哈哈哈哈哈！

column1: I can't, my therapist and I have an agreement.

column1: I better not, my scoutmaster warned me to be careful.
